Enacted AI laws in New Jersey

1 law this site judged relevant to AI, newest first, each read from its enrolled text.

  • A3497: Establishes "Forbidding the Algorithmic Inflation of Rent (FAIR) Act." passed 2026-07-20

    This act, known as the Forbidding the Algorithmic Inflation of Rent (FAIR) Act, makes it unlawful and a violation of the New Jersey Antitrust Act for rental property owners to use coordinators that perform algorithmic coordinating functions, for coordinators to facilitate agreements restricting competition, and for any person to perform a coordinating function or engage in parallel pricing coordination (Sec. 1, Sec. 4). It defines key terms such as algorithmic device, coordinating function, coordinator, and parallel pricing coordination, and directs the Attorney General to establish a complaint location (Sec. 3, Sec. 7).
